topics.title: Capstone: E-Commerce Store with Context & Cart
topics.description: Full-featured shopping experience with catalog, quantity selector, promo codes, and 1-Click GitHub sync.

guidedProject.title: Zenith Store: React E-Commerce Platform
guidedProject.description:
Build a small e-commerce application as the final practice project.

The student should learn by increasing complexity:
1. Render products.
2. Add items to a cart.
3. Display cart count.
4. Change quantities.
5. Derive totals.
6. Extract cart state into a reducer.
7. Share cart state with Context.
8. Apply a promotion.
9. Show a cart drawer and summary.
10. Prepare the project for deployment/GitHub.

Keep one source of truth for cart data. Do not create separate state values for every derived number when the value can be calculated from the cart.
